### News

- For the spring of 2027, I'll be based at RWTH Aachen.
- We put out a [chapter](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18420) on arXiv for an upcoming book, Social Networks Beyond Pairwise Interactions, to appear in the [Computational Social Sciences series](https://link.springer.com/series/11784?srsltid=AfmBOoo-0ERcoBkTPgvEY_IPNPnGprCqFAo9QQyr-xyt4-VblFclRnYx) by Springer
